analytics.eventDeliveryReason: Google Analytics Data API is disabled for project foam-party, no BigQuery Analytics export dataset was visible, and no Android device was connected over ADB for DebugView/logcat verification.

notes: Do not store service account JSON, private keys, or Admin SDK credentials in the client repo.
The mobile config files are client app configuration files, not Admin SDK credentials.

iOS GoogleService-Info.plist contains the legacy/generated IS_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=false flag. Do not treat that flag alone as proof that current Firebase Analytics collection is disabled; verify event delivery in Firebase DebugView before release.
Enable analyticsdata.googleapis.com and grant Analytics property read access to the automation service account before using GA Realtime API as an automated event-delivery gate.
